home.paragraph1: Nataliia is an experienced dental hygienist (6 years), recognized for her groundbreaking invention, the painless teeth whitening method known as “Apollonia”.
home.paragraph2: Originally from Ukraine and educated in Canada, she is committed to making every dental procedure a comfortable and relaxing experience for her clients.

hero.title: Whitening, as it should have been
hero.subtitle: I'm Nataliia, the only hygienist in this room, the inventor of the protocol on the menu, and the person who'll lower the chair for you. Here is what I believe - and why.

list.title: It must not hurt.
list.description: Sensitivity is the silent reason most people never finish whitening. Every protocol on our menu is built around three sensitivity controls - gum sealants, hydroxyapatite, fluoride - before peroxide ever enters the room.

list.title: Light over chemistry.
list.description: We use less peroxide than most studios, and pair it with red-light LED therapy. The light does the work the chemistry would have done - but kinder, and faster to dissipate.

list.title: Enamel before shade.
list.description: A whiter tooth that's been etched and dehydrated isn't whiter for long. Hydroxyapatite reseals the surface at the end of every session. The shade you leave with is the shade you keep.

list.title: One chair, one hygienist.
list.description: Apollonia is intentionally small. The person who plans your treatment is the person who performs it. No rotating staff, no upsell scripts. It is not for everyone but if it's for you, you'll know.

steps.title: Diagnostic shade reading
steps.description: We read your enamel against the VITA classical scale. A target is set in writing.

steps.title: Gum protection & isolation
steps.description: A light-cure resin protects every millimetre of soft tissue.

steps.title: First LED whitening pass
steps.description: First fifteen minutes under the blue-red dual lamp at clinical strength.

steps.title: Red-light recovery interval
steps.description: Red-light only. Enamel rehydrates; tissue calms; you breathe.

steps.title: Second LED whitening pass
steps.description: Second pass, same strength. This is where the bulk of the shift happens.

steps.title: Hydroxyapatite reseal & polish
steps.description: A remineralising gel locks the new shade in. We re-read your VITA card.

materials.title: Six things, chosen carefully.
materials.subtitle: We don't carry a long shelf. Every material in the operatory earned its place because it does one thing well - and doesn't ask you to feel it.

items.label: Carbamide peroxide
items.caption: The whitening agent. Lower concentration than most studios-light makes up the difference.

items.label: Red-light LED
items.caption: 650-nm therapy light. Accelerates peroxide breakdown and reduces gum inflammation.

items.label: Hydroxyapatite
items.caption: The mineral your enamel is made of. Reseals microporosity after every session.

items.label: Fluoride varnish
items.caption: Strengthens the surface against staining for the first 24 hours - the window that matters.

items.label: 24K gold gel
items.caption: Used only in the Golden Glow method. Reduces sensitivity further; leaves teeth softer to the tongue.

items.label: Air polishing
items.caption: Sodium bicarbonate at low pressure for surface stain. Optional, gentle, fast.

text.paragraph1: Nataliia was born and trained in Ukraine, then completed her dental hygiene qualifications in Canada. She spent her first three Canadian years working chairs that ran on volume - six minutes, fluoride, next — and learned mostly what she didn't want to do.
text.paragraph2: In 2019 she opened a single-chair room on Eglinton, three blocks east of Forest Hill subway, and started writing protocols by hand on graph paper. Apollonia was the protocol she stopped throwing out.
text.paragraph3: Today the studio sees a few patients a day, by reservation, with the same hygienist every visit. She prefers it that way; her patients seem to as well.

professionalTeethCleaning.title: Professional Teeth Cleaning
professionalTeethCleaning.description: Ultrasonic scaling followed by manual scaling and polishing.Add-ons as per client request: air polishing, AirFlow cleaning and fluoride.

painlessTeethWhiteningTreatment.title: Painless Teeth Whitening Treatment
painlessTeethWhiteningTreatment.description: LED whitening with red light therapy (anti inflammatory), gum protection and anti-sensitivity dental grade materials (fluoride and hydroxyapatite). 2 applications 15 min each will get you 8-10 shades whiter. Recommended for yellowish-white teeth to achieve white results and for white teeth to achieve extremely white results. 70 min procedure.

teethWhiteningMaintenanceSession.title: Teeth Whitening 3-6 Months Maintenance Session
teethWhiteningMaintenanceSession.description: Quick maintenance session recommended 3-6 months after initial whitening (35-40mins).

whiteSpotLesionsRemoval.title: White Spot Lesions Removal
whiteSpotLesionsRemoval.description: Icon® Infiltration Concept is used for the microinvasive treatment of white dental lesions. In one patient visit, and with no drilling, Icon® can arrest the progression of early enamel white spot caries-like lesions (demineralization).

toothGems.title: Tooth Gems
toothGems.description: No drilling. Applied with dental bond and orthodontic composite resin. Can be polished off any time as needed.

customTeethWhiteningTrays.title: Custom Teeth Whitening Trays
customTeethWhiteningTrays.description: Designed to hold a whitening gel against your teeth, helping to lighten stains and discoloration

sportsguard.title: Sportsguard
sportsguard.description: Custom fit protective device worn over the teeth — typically covering the upper teeth — to safeguard the mouth from injuries during sports and physical activities.
